explanation_full: The feature distributions indicate that Ethanol (mean: 0.4736) and Acetate (mean: 0.4465) possess the highest average values among the measured features. These findings suggest that Ethanol and Acetate are the most abundant features, while Ethanol and Butyrate are the most variable.
